labels.variantDefinition: Editable samples scattered through the page are all restyled by one persistent toolbar (subfamily, weight, size, alignment, alternates)
labels.look: Black band, three centred lines of white bold display serif 'GRAPHIC DESIGN / Graphic Designers need a wide Variety in Characters'
labels.ux: contenteditable line; a site-wide style bar (about 20 editable blocks) changes subfamily, weight, size, alignment, alts
labels.learn: Make every specimen line in the story editable and drive them from one toolbar: reading and testing become the same act

labels.variantDefinition: The alphabet runs as one large line moving across the viewport (marquee or looping video), often over metric guidelines
labels.look: Grey field, blue 'TECHNICAL SHEET' title block with spec blurb, giant blue lowercase 'klmnopq' cropped on yellow metric lines
labels.ux: Looping muted video (presumably the alphabet sliding over the guidelines); floating Get the font button
labels.learn: Draw the vertical metrics as thin lines behind a huge alphabet: it reads as a technical drawing with no labels needed

labels.look: Cream, blue italic headlines 'Renounce Boring' and 'Variety the Spice of Life' with emoji-like glyphs, pole labels FINE / FINE ITALIC and CONDENSED / EXTENDED
labels.ux: Headlines animate roman to italic and across widths; a dot travels between the labelled poles; sticky trial/licensing bar
labels.learn: Label the two extremes on either side and let a dot travel between them: a slider-like reading of an animation, no controls needed

labels.variantDefinition: Rows of prose plus a sample word with technical annotations (stem measurements, ink-trap zooms, advance widths, italic angle), one design decision per row
labels.look: White, thin rules, words 'Heat', 'MAX', 'Raw', 'Refitment', 'Safe' with measurements, zoomed ink-trap tiles and a protractor; scribbled line drawings
labels.ux: static (some figures animate, e.g. width comparison)
labels.learn: One decision per row, each proved on a word with real numbers (stems 47/30, widths 628/519): explains craft without jargon walls

labels.look: Off-white, intro sentence full of alternates and diacritics ('{ Mąthieu Desjardins }'), big 'E' roundel, then a 10-column character grid in encoding order
labels.ux: Long scroll through the grid; side 'Table of contents' tab, Invert colours toggle, Get the font
labels.learn: Open the charset with a sentence that smuggles in the alternates and accents, so the grid that follows feels earned

labels.variantDefinition: A syntax-highlighted code editor set in the font, with example files in several languages and switchable editor themes, plus paste-your-own code
labels.look: Dark editor theme, orange strings, a multilingual pangram table (lang(af, …)) formatted as source code
labels.ux: Editable code area; Theme (white/light/dark/black) and Example (c, py, swift, js, less, html) switched from the controls above
labels.learn: Test a coding font where it will live: real code, real highlighting, the visitor's own theme

labels.look: Pink-to-violet gradient, one editable sci-fi title per style ('Rocket Ship Galileo', 'Fahrenheit 451'), tiny mono style label left, three-way toggle right
labels.ux: Each row is editable and has its own Geometric/Rounded/Gothic alternate-set toggle; sticky section nav with Try/Buy
labels.learn: Seed each row with a themed title (sci-fi novels) so the default text tells the font's story before anyone types

labels.variantDefinition: The making-of told step by step (first sketch, iterations, key decisions), with the evolving letterforms shown at each stage
labels.look: Black, white calligraphic 'a', large prose paragraph, 'Calligraphy' then 'Geometric Construction' with stage labels Starting point / Standard / Fine
labels.learn: Show the journey from the first letter to the final system, so the two subfamilies read as two ends of one process

labels.look: White, pairs of large sample lines (default vs feature on) with tiny feature tags (cv01, ss02, tnum, zero), closing table of all features
labels.ux: static comparisons; sticky nav (Features, Glyphs, FAQ, Lab, Download)
labels.learn: Pair each sample with the exact feature codes that produce it, then end with the complete feature index for reference
